raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a pie chart showing the distribution across three year categories, with three slices labeled 2017, 2018, and 2019. The 2019 slice is colored blue and is labeled 46.0% (46), the 2018 slice is colored orange and is labeled 33.0% (33), and the 2017 slice is colored green and is labeled 21.0% (21). Percentage and count labels appear inside each slice, while the year labels are placed just outside the pie near their respective segments. There is no separate legend and no slices are exploded or otherwise emphasized; visually, the slices appear arranged so that the largest (2019) is followed by 2018 and then 2017.
